values: A relation-incidence proof of Tohăneanu's low-exponent supersolvability conjecture. Full characteristic-zero result, including all ranks, products and nonessential arrangements; five-page note and exact verification package. Extensively AI-assisted; unrefereed, no independent human peer review. Credits earlier methods and Ferudun's matching October 12 preprint; no exhaustive first-priority claim. PR #618: https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/618

Forward generation does not ensure GNS descent: an explicit continuous counterexample. Skeide's first module-approach problem, OWR 2009 pp. 542–543; catalogue ID 30001184 / OWR-3392-012. Accepted negative counterexample to generation-only universal GNS descent for general unital C*-E0 dilations. Explicit corollary of Burgarth-Facchi-Hillier's established clock/evaluation/translated-unitary mechanism; conditional extension after kernel invariance, stronger minimality and normal W*-promotion remain unresolved here. Extensively AI-assisted; unrefereed, no independent human peer review or exhaustive first-priority claim. PR #623: https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/623

A qualitative pre-Schwarzian improvement for real schlicht functions. Hayman-Lingham Problem 6.86, printed p. 147; catalogue 2306086 / AMR-022-6086. Accepted qualitative fixed-nonreal-point improvement uniform over the normalized real-coefficient schlicht class; uniform gap on compact nonreal sets, sharp classical real-diameter radius, zero source expression at zero. Classical coefficient equality, slit rigidity and compactness. Explicit upper gap, sharp quantitative radius and general extremizers undetermined. Bounded priority audit retains Jenkins (1960) and Aleksandrov-Popova (1973) original-source limits; no historical firstness, exhaustive novelty clearance or current-openness guarantee. Extensively AI-assisted; unrefereed, without independent human peer review. PR #662: https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/662

Counterexamples to Satoh's SL(2) representation-filtration conjecture. Satoh, OWR 2018, pp. 88-89; catalogue 30003703 / OWR-15987-013. Explicit counterexamples refute the original 2018 equality for the rational SL(2) matrix-entry component algebra: D_n(5) != A_n(5) for every n >= 4 and D_n(6) != A_n(6) for every n >= 3. A uses the integral free-group lower central series; D acts on the whole J quotient. Classical Burde/Razmyslov identity credit; no new PI identity or general PI method claimed. No degree-5 rank-3, every-degree, higher-SL_m, character-algebra or ordinary IA lower-central conjecture claim. Bounded priority audit retains 2017/2021 journal and 2025/2026 related-journal source-access limits; no historical firstness, exhaustive novelty clearance or current-openness certificate. AI tools used extensively; unrefereed, without independent human peer review; internal AI review is not human peer review. PR #681: https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/681
